title: A rotated work offset is display-only: toolpath and machining planes stay in world axes (#315 step 3)
body:
**What happens**

The 3-2-1 alignment (#187) and `SetWcsOrigin` can set a rotated work offset, and the viewport shows the rotated frame — but nothing downstream machines in it:

- Toolpaths generate in world axes; only the offset's translation (`wcs_context` → `OriginX/Y/Z`) reaches the record stream (`posting_wcs_rotation.rs`).
- Heights / machining planes stay world-Z.
- The post refuses a rotated offset by name (#315, shipped in v0.15.0) — correct and safe, but by then the user has built a state the whole page presented as valid: the display shows a frame the CAM does not machine.

User-reported on main 5fd45923: align a setup's WCS with 3-2-1 on a turned part → the WCS is right in the display, toolpath and machining plane do not follow. Not yet pinned by a test.

**Fix (step 3 of #315, owed)**

Carry the rotation end-to-end, as a user parameter with a default:

- generation and heights compute in the offset's frame, so toolpath and machining planes follow the alignment, and
- the post either bakes rotated coordinates into the program or emits the control's own rotation where the machine declares it (Fanuc G68 / G68.2, Siemens CYCLE800 / ROT, Heidenhain PLANE / CYCL 10 — public control documentation only; a G54 register is translation only on every control).

Interim, if the full carry is not taken at once: the 3-2-1 flow should say at alignment time that a rotated offset will not post (the refusal currently arrives only at the post gate), or steer to part alignment (#330, #746).

**Done means**

A part aligned with a rotated work offset machines in that frame: toolpath, height planes and posted program all carry the same rotation, pinned against a hand-computed program — or the alignment refuses with a clear message before any toolpath exists. Never a display that shows a frame nothing machines.

**Related**: #315 (the shipped refusal), #187 (3-2-1 alignment), #330 / #746 (part alignment, the alternative path), #701 (will create rotated offsets from feature roles and needs this to machine them).
